events.title: Drop In Adult Pickleball
events.description: A racquet sport that combines elements of badminton, tennis and table tennis. Pickleball is played on a court with the same dimensions as a doubles badminton court. The net is similar to a tennis net but is mounted lower. This game is played with a hard paddle and a whiffle ball. Beginners welcome.
